scope: Independent bounded review of six existing desktop saved images only

observations.text: The title Waves in a medium and chapter/page line are fully visible. The first viewport has a stable centered reading column, clear dark text, comfortable line spacing, and distinct paragraph gaps. The legacy polarization filename actually shows the opening lesson viewport.

The complete display maintains readable text and consistent alignment through the closing paragraphs. Seven thin horizontal concept boundaries, paragraph spacing, and bold key terms visibly organize the progression. No incoherent text overlap, missing-looking text blocks, or clipped line endings were observed; the final lines retain bottom whitespace.

The approved generated ripple picture is clear at the bound 640px media width, with discernible rings and an undistorted landscape frame. It is centered within the prose column and does not collide with surrounding text. The prose identifies Figure 64; this saved display has no separate printed Figure 64 caption.

Figure 73 has crisp dark strokes, distinguishable parallel lines, a complete left plate, and intact right-facing arrowheads. Its internal line crossings are coherent diagram intersections, not layout overlap. White margins and the separate Figure 73 caption keep the figure distinct from adjacent prose.

Figure 74 retains the full tray, feet, projecting rod, and interior line pattern with clear strokes and whitespace around the apparatus. No part touches or is cut by the saved frame. The Figure 74 caption is readable and separate from the following figure.

Figure 75 shows clean concentric rings, a distinguishable dashed inner ring and central mark, and eight complete outward arrowheads. Ring/ray crossings remain visually coherent. The square figure and Figure 75 caption fit without collision with the surrounding section divider or prose.

Only the top of Figure 64 enters the bottom of the first viewport. This is normal viewport continuation, not a clipped figure: the complete-course image and saved figure image show the full media frame.

The six inspected image SHA256 values match the desktop screenshot bindings in the current report. Its desktop view records 34 paragraphs, four figures, zero original tasks, loaded fonts, and an empty errors array. The report remains an existing DOM check with pixel review pending; it was not modified by this review.

limitations: PASS applies only to the six bound desktop saved images and their visible display organization; it is not headed acceptance, online certification, production verification, or a complete accessibility approval.
The images were produced by isolated headless offline evidence. No browser was launched, no interaction was exercised, and no new screenshot was created during this review.
No mobile images were opened or assessed. Static desktop pixels do not establish responsive behavior or scroll interaction.
Source-bound Chinese ARIA labels remain in the English display and are disclosed in the bound report. Saved pixels do not establish their screen-reader behavior or certify English accessibility.
Prior science and figure-semantic approvals were reused as the task's supplied baseline. No original source, science derivation, figure specification, or bilingual prose was rereviewed.

Media widths and paragraph/task counts are attributed to the bound DOM report, not inferred from the screenshot container widths. This review makes no independent minimum-font-size or embedded-raster-glyph certification.
The full-course image was opened once without crops or reopens. Detailed first-viewport and four-figure inspection used only the five separately supplied saved images, each opened once.
Bindings identify the inspected saved evidence only. Any later change to a bound image or report makes this review stale for that changed evidence.
